port.md): ONE run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_gateable, or not_configured.\n- [E
nable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/enable-repoint-or-disable-a-suites-
schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment-based suite must pin exactly one of its attached en
vironments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite means that environment; omitting it on a multi-environment suit
e is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…\n- [Launch one run per target as a group (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/
api-reference/eval-runs/launch-one-run-per-target-as-a-group-async.md): Launches ONE run per target — attached project environment
s, or attached named hosts — under a single **server-minted** `runGroupId`, then detaches execution and responds `202` with a per-
target receipt.\n- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-ev
al-suite-author-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite — the suite record plus its test cases — and responds `201` *
*synchronously**, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs` (passing the re
turned `suiteId`).\n- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resolve-or-creat
e-a-file-owned-eval-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is by `(project
Id, declaredSuiteId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector parses the su
ite file; this body is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…\n- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpj
am.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings — attached environments, hosts, ex
ecution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.\n-
[Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and its cases.
Past runs are not deleted.\n- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-sui
tes-settings.md): Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/repl
aces, `null` clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds
with the full updated suite.\n- [Get the pre-run disclosure for a suite launch plan](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-r
uns/get-the-pre-run-disclosure-for-a-suite-launch-plan.md): What happens to a run's content BEFORE you launch it: which models it
calls and where they route, which LLM analyzers/judges can fire and where their evidence goes, capture/retention/region facts, and
the subprocessors engaged. Read-only — never launches or gates a run. Keyed by the SAME destination…\n- [List a suite's eval case
s](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the public steps-firs
t shape.\n- [Create an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one case to the su
ite. Both `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are required — `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partia
l, but a case persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.\n
- [Create several eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 cases
to the suite in one call — the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test files withou
t a round trip per case. Every entry needs a `title` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are validated together and reported indi
vidually: a `failed…\n- [Generate eval cases from the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/generate-eval
-cases-from-the-suites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, generates cases against them, and
persists them — the only edit route that connects to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconnect, respond.\n- [
Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): The sibl
ing of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person already wrot
e — a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered steps,
tool calls, assertions), so the…\n- [Read an eval authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/read-an-eval-auth
oring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this after a `202`, then commit t
he job once its `status` is `completed`.\n- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carryi
ng unresolved blocking issues or proposed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `rev
iewUrl` for finishing it in the app.\n- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md):
A case that belongs to this suite and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n- [Delete an eval case](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suite. Past runs that executed it are not a
ffected.\n- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update — omitte
d fields are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `c
hecks` accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.\n- [Upload a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact referenced by an ingested run (typically widget HTML t
oo large to send inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's results then reference. This is what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpja
m/sdk` uses for widget evidence.\n- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-
upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` with `code: \"FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED\"` and `details.c
ode: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending its bytes to `POST /projects/{proj
ectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, which returns the `storageId` the run's results…\n- [Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabili
ties](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticated-eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discover authenticat
ed eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsu
pported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Persist advisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/per
sist-advisory-case-run-evaluations.md): Persist advisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenan
t/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Ingest a completed eval run in one call](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-eval-run-in-one-call.md): The whole-run variant: submit a finishe
d run and its iterations in a single request. This is what the SDK reporter uses by default.\n- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hos
ted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval
running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of
its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/a
pi-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed project, imme
